t: A twelve-joint robot dog that walks from your web browser.
steps: Buy the BASIC, EX, or PI5 kit from the Waveshare store.
Charge the battery pack with the included 8.4 V charger.
Switch the robot on and join its Wi-Fi hotspot from a phone or laptop.
Open the control page in a web browser and try walking and turning.
Turn on the self-balancing mode and test it on a tilted board.
Follow the Waveshare wiki to record your first custom action.
Add a Raspberry Pi and run the setup script for the camera web app.
Try the face detection and color tracking demos.
